recap.title: Death recap
recap.window: Damage taken in the last 15 s

hourboard.hint: Fighters still in are ranked by takedowns, then by damage to fighters. Anyone who is out keeps their place.
stat.hp.name: Health
stat.hp.tip: The damage you can take before you fall.
stat.hpRegen.name: Health regeneration
stat.res.name: Resource
stat.res.tip: The pool your abilities draw on. Its kind depends on the fighter.
stat.resRegen.name: Resource regeneration
stat.ad.name: Attack
stat.ad.tip: Adds to your basic attack damage and to abilities that scale with attack.
stat.ap.name: Power
stat.ap.tip: Adds to the damage and effect of abilities that scale with power.
stat.armor.name: Armor
stat.armor.tip: Reduces physical damage you take. At 100 armor you take half.
stat.resist.name: Resist
stat.resist.tip: Reduces magic damage you take. At 100 resist you take half.
stat.attackSpeed.name: Attack speed
stat.moveSpeed.name: Move speed
stat.moveSpeed.tip: How many metres you cover each second.
stat.moveSpeedPct.name: Move speed bonus
stat.moveSpeedPct.tip: Extra move speed as a percentage of your base.
stat.crit.name: Critical chance
stat.crit.tip: The chance a basic attack lands as a critical strike for extra damage.
stat.critDamage.name: Critical damage
stat.critDamage.tip: How much extra damage a critical strike deals.
stat.lifesteal.name: Life steal
stat.lifesteal.tip: Heals you for a share of the damage your basic attacks deal.
stat.omnivamp.name: Drain
stat.omnivamp.tip: Heals you for a share of all the damage you deal, from attacks and abilities.
stat.haste.name: Ability haste
stat.haste.tip: Shortens ability cooldowns; 100 haste halves them. Battle spells and item actives are not affected.
stat.range.name: Attack range
stat.range.tip: How far away your basic attacks reach, in metres.
stat.armorPen.name: Armor penetration
stat.armorPen.tip: Your attacks and abilities ignore this much of the target's armor.
stat.armorPenPct.name: Armor penetration %
stat.armorPenPct.tip: Your attacks and abilities ignore this share of the target's armor.
stat.magicPen.name: Magic penetration
stat.magicPen.tip: Your abilities ignore this much of the target's resist.
stat.magicPenPct.name: Magic penetration %
stat.magicPenPct.tip: Your abilities ignore this share of the target's resist.
stat.tenacity.name: Tenacity
stat.tenacity.tip: Shortens stuns, roots, slows, silences, fear, taunts and sleep. Capped at 90%.
stat.healShieldPower.name: Heal and shield power
stat.healShieldPower.tip: Strengthens the heals and shields you give.
stat.kills.name: Takedowns
stat.deaths.name: Falls
stat.deaths.tip: The number of times you fell.
stat.assists.name: Assists
stat.kda.name: T / F / A
stat.cs.name: Wicks
stat.cs.tip: Wicks and monsters you finished off. Each pays Gleam.
stat.gold.name: Gleam
stat.gold.tip: The currency you spend at the Lampwright.
stat.goldEarned.name: Gleam earned
stat.goldEarned.tip: All the Gleam you earned this match, spent or not.
stat.damage.name: Damage to fighters
stat.damage.tip: Damage you dealt to enemy fighters.
stat.damageTaken.name: Damage taken
stat.healing.name: Healing
stat.healing.tip: Health and shield you gave, yourself included.
stat.structureDamage.name: Structure damage
stat.structureDamage.tip: Damage you dealt to enemy structures.
stat.streak.name: Streak
stat.streak.tip: Takedowns in a row without falling. A long streak raises your bounty.
stat.bounty.name: Bounty
stat.bounty.tip: The Gleam paid to whoever takes this fighter down. It grows with a streak.
stat.level.name: Level
stat.level.tip: Higher levels strengthen your fighter and unlock ability ranks.
stat.xp.name: XP
stat.xp.tip: Experience toward the next level. It is shared by fighters near a fall.
stat.difficulty.name: Difficulty
stat.difficulty.tip: How much practice a fighter needs.
status.stun.name: Stunned
status.root.name: Rooted
status.root.tip: Cannot move. Can still attack and cast.
status.slow.name: Slowed
status.silence.name: Silenced
status.silence.tip: Cannot cast abilities. Battle spells and items still work.
status.disarm.name: Disarmed
status.airborne.name: Airborne
status.airborne.tip: Lifted off the ground and cannot act.
status.taunt.name: Taunted
status.taunt.tip: Forced to attack whoever taunted it.
status.fear.name: Feared
status.fear.tip: Forced to walk away and cannot attack or cast.
status.sleep.name: Asleep
status.sleep.tip: Cannot act until it takes damage.
status.haste.name: Hasted
status.invisible.name: Hidden
status.invisible.tip: Cannot be seen by enemies until it attacks or casts.
status.untargetable.name: Untargetable
status.untargetable.tip: Enemies cannot target or hit it.
status.unstoppable.name: Unstoppable
status.unstoppable.tip: Cannot be stopped by stuns, roots, fear, taunts or sleep.
status.reveal.name: Revealed
status.reveal.tip: Visible to the enemy team through fog, grass and invisibility.
status.grievous.name: Wounded
status.armor_shred.name: Armor broken
status.resist_shred.name: Resist broken

settings.title: Settings
settings.changes_saved: Changes are saved as you make them.
settings.video.preset.label: Quality preset
settings.video.preset.desc: Sets the options below together. Changing any one of them switches this to Custom.
settings.video.renderScale.label: Render scale
settings.video.renderScale.desc: Draws the game at this share of your screen's size. Lower is faster and softer.
settings.video.shadows.label: Shadows
settings.video.shadows.desc: Shadow detail. Off is the fastest.
settings.video.ao.label: Ambient occlusion
settings.video.ao.desc: Soft contact shadows where objects meet the ground.
settings.video.bloom.label: Bloom
settings.video.bloom.desc: The soft halo around bright light. Danger areas read the same with it off.
settings.video.antialias.label: Edge smoothing
settings.video.antialias.desc: Smooths jagged edges. SMAA is light and MSAA is heavier and sharper.
settings.video.particles.label: Effects detail
settings.video.particles.desc: How many sparks, chips and shards effects throw.
settings.video.scatter.label: Scenery detail
settings.video.scatter.desc: Grass, stones and small props across the map.
settings.video.fpsCap.label: Frame rate limit
settings.video.fpsCap.desc: Caps frames per second to save power and heat.
settings.video.maxDpr.label: Sharpness
settings.video.maxDpr.desc: The highest pixel ratio the game draws at. Higher is sharper on dense screens and costs more.
settings.video.fullscreen.label: Fullscreen
settings.video.note: Every quality level draws danger areas the same way.
settings.audio.master.label: Master volume
settings.audio.music.label: Music
settings.audio.sfx.label: Effects
settings.audio.voice.label: Announcer
settings.audio.voice.desc: Announcer tones for takedowns and objectives.
settings.audio.ui.label: Interface
settings.audio.ambience.label: Ambience
settings.audio.ambience.desc: Wind and the sounds of each map.
settings.audio.muteInBackground.label: Mute in the background
settings.audio.muteInBackground.desc: Silences the game while this tab is hidden.
settings.controls.binds.title: Keys
settings.controls.binds.desc: Click a key, then press the key or mouse button you want.
settings.controls.press_key: Press a key or mouse button for {action}.
settings.controls.quickCast.label: Quick cast
settings.controls.quickCast.desc: Abilities fire at the cursor the moment you press their key.
settings.controls.cameraLock.label: Lock camera to your fighter
settings.controls.cameraLock.desc: Keeps the camera centred on your fighter.
settings.controls.edgePan.label: Edge pan
settings.controls.edgePan.desc: Move the cursor to a screen edge to scroll the camera.
settings.controls.panSpeed.label: Pan speed
settings.controls.attackMoveOnClick.desc: Move commands also attack enemies you pass.
settings.controls.selfCastModifier.label: Self-cast key
settings.controls.selfCastModifier.desc: Hold this key with an ability to cast it on yourself.
settings.access.colorblind.label: Colourblind mode
settings.access.colorblind.desc: Changes the ally and enemy colours. Shape codes stay on in every mode.
settings.access.colorblind.opt_desc.off: Allies are Dawn azure and enemies are Dusk marigold.
settings.access.colorblind.opt_desc.deut: Enemies shift to a brighter yellow-orange. Allies shift slightly toward cyan.
settings.access.colorblind.opt_desc.prot: Enemies shift to a brighter yellow-orange.
settings.access.colorblind.opt_desc.trit: Enemies shift to a rose-red. Allies shift slightly toward cyan.
settings.access.colors.title: Team colours
settings.access.colors.desc: Your colour is Noonwhite. Neutral things are Dialstone.
settings.access.colors.warn: These two colours are hard to tell apart. Pick colours further apart.
settings.access.fray.label: FRAY seat colours
settings.access.fray.desc: How the other nine fighters are drawn in FRAY. Each seat always has its own glyph.
settings.access.fray.opt_desc.auto: Stamp-forward when a colourblind mode is on, otherwise Standard.
settings.access.fray.opt_desc.standard: Ten seat colours, each with its glyph.
settings.access.fray.opt_desc.stamp: Glyphs at 150% and a stronger fill, so each seat reads by shape first.
settings.access.fray.opt_desc.simple: Everyone else is drawn in the enemy colour with their glyph, so only you stand out.
settings.access.uiScale.label: UI scale
settings.access.hudScale.label: HUD scale
settings.access.hudScale.desc: Resizes the in-match bars, frames and feeds.
settings.access.minimapScale.label: Minimap scale
settings.access.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
settings.access.reduceMotion.desc: Replaces sweeps and camera moves with short fades.
settings.access.screenShake.label: Screen shake
settings.access.screenShake.desc: How hard the screen shakes on big hits. Zero turns it off.
settings.access.subtitles.label: Subtitles
settings.access.subtitles.desc: Shows announcer text for takedowns, objectives and structures.
settings.gameplay.showDamageNumbers.desc: Shows your own hits, and heals of 5% of max health or more.
settings.gameplay.showAllyIndicators.des: Shows frames and marks for allied fighters.
settings.gameplay.healthBarTicks.label: Health bar ticks
settings.gameplay.healthBarTicks.desc: Marks every 100 health on bars, with a heavier mark every 1,000.
settings.gameplay.minimapSide.label: Minimap side
settings.gameplay.minimapSide.desc: Which bottom corner the minimap sits in.
